title: Your street comes to life
summary: Walk your neighborhood in Street view, design your yard in the new Your Streetview editor, and watch neighbors and lights bring the city to life.
changes: Added Street view. Drag the little person onto a highlighted street, or select it and choose a street, to explore the city in first person.
Added Your Streetview, a top-down editor opened from your tower layers. Pick a 3D model from the shelf to preview it, snap it to your plot's grid, rotate it, and place it without leaving the editor.
Spend bricks on flower planters, benches, lamps, small trees, sculptures, neighbors, and corner shops. Level 4 towers can add storefronts that sit flush against the building's walls.
Pick up your own items in Street view, walk them somewhere new, and set them down again. Moving items you already own is free.
Neighbors you buy now stroll to nearby shops and head back home, walking around buildings and furnishings.
The city follows your local time of day. Lamps and shop windows warmly light the sidewalks in the evening, and lighting stays steady while you pan.
Wild woodland now grows around undeveloped land beyond the city's edge.
A new neighborhood guide spotlights real controls and moves forward as you open the editor, place your first item, and start a walk. Skip it anytime or replay it from Settings.
The city draws faster and more smoothly as it grows, and recovers if your graphics context is interrupted.
Purchases interrupted by a lost connection now finish safely, without charging twice or losing the item's placement.
